study.comparator: insulin lispro three times daily (both arms on titrated insulin glargine)
study.notes: 2013 conference abstract of the 4B trial: exenatide twice daily (dose not stated in the abstract, 0.01 mg entered as the licensed 10 ug dose to confirm) plus insulin glargine vs mealtime insulin lispro plus glargine, 30 week intervention after a 12 week basal insulin optimisation phase, metformin treated T2D, 637 randomised 1:1 (316 vs 321; per protocol 247 vs 263); LS mean changes per arm with a between group p value and no dispersion (route arm_means_exact_p); weight treatment difference -4.6 kg [-5.2 to -3.9] (baseline weight not in the abstract, so pct_weight_change empty); hsCRP, adiponectin and UACR without significant differences and without numbers; cardiovascular risk factors were secondary outcomes (TRUE); sponsor Eli Lilly (industry); extracted by the session (S), 2026-10-16

rows.notes: LS mean change from randomisation to week 30, exenatide arm -4.1 vs lispro arm +0.4 mmHg, between group p=0.0004

json.design: randomised open label active comparator, 30 weeks, 637 randomised

rob.justification: randomised 1:1 (D1 low); open label insulin regimens (D2 some concerns); per protocol sets 247 and 263 of 316 and 321 with no analysis of the missing in the abstract (D3 some concerns); laboratory and clinic outcomes (D4 low); prespecified secondary outcomes (D5 low)

doubts: companion full paper needed (Diamant 2014 Diabetes Care by the trial name)
